scientific_integrity: Exact finite enumeration is exhaustive by a connected-incidence-rank and integrality theorem; the maximum facet size and its equality structure have a separate analytic proof; no independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the unweighted ten-vertex triangular graph over the real field; classification of facets under graph symmetries and sign, not every linear isometry, no infinite family or full face vector. Bibliographic completeness is not certified.
title: Facet and symmetry classification of the triangular graph transportation ball
